concerns.text: The plan states it will generate quantized versions at six bit depths (1, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16) (see Summary). This conflicts with FR‑002 in the specification, which requires a *minimum* quantization depth of 4 bits. Including a 1‑bit depth violates the functional requirement.

FR‑015 (sensitivity analysis to verify the additivity assumption) is listed in the specification but has no corresponding task or implementation in the plan. The plan’s coverage map does not map FR‑015 to any task, leaving the requirement unaddressed.
